description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Izzet Chronarch.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Izzet Chronarch, adding {B}.
When Izzet Chronarch dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
